name: Xylitol
siboNotes: Xylitol is a polyol that feeds bacteria in the small intestine and should be completely avoided during SIBO treatment. Even small amounts can trigger significant digestive symptoms.
preparationTips: Always read ingredient labels as xylitol is common in sugar-free products
Check gum, mints, and diabetic foods for xylitol content
Look for alternative names like birch sugar on labels
Be aware that xylitol is toxic to dogs
pairsWellWith: Use alternatives in baking with gluten-free flours
Combine maple syrup with low-FODMAP fruits
Use rice malt syrup in homemade granola
Pair monk fruit with low-FODMAP spices like cinnamon
